basis: Editorial research order based on reusable mechanic questions and current coverage gaps, not hero popularity, win rate or certified counter strength.

batches.title: 1. Control and channel interactions
questions: Follow up with controlled tests: Knockdown delay vs short channels; protection, removal and Cursed Relic interactions.
Still open: Static Charge removal, continuous-stun duration reduction, qualifying barrier triggers and personal survival.
Seven damage markers and Dynamo channel flag are traced to raw properties; alternate tooltip sections and other kit details remain incomplete.
batches.status: First slice reviewed: six conditional channel-interrupt rules; no in-game verification or full-kit coverage.

batches.title: 2. Healing and persistent damage
questions: Test recipient-specific anti-heal application, Kelvin dome purge/reapplication and buildup timing.
Resolve turret-trigger attribution, Victor aura toggle interruption and reanimation health separately.
Extend player delivery coverage beyond the four reviewed heroes without assuming every spirit effect procs identically.
batches.status: First slice reviewed: healing denial, conditional spirit shielding and separate Inhibitor responses. In-game testing and full-kit coverage remain open.

batches.title: 3. Flight, movement and escape
questions: Check movement denial, delivery range and defensive activation windows.
Distinguish flight, teleport, untargetability and invisibility.
Review execute wording separately from ordinary bonus damage against low-health targets.

gates: Repair incomplete ability text and alternate-kit gaps before relying on those profiles.
Read current item facts and independent matchup evidence for each proposed interaction.
Record exact affected ability, objective, conditions, exclusions, player scope and patch.
Add behavioral regressions and keep untested interactions labeled source-reviewed.
